basic_details.job_title: BECIL Principal Chief Projects Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

qualification.education_qualification: B.E/B. Tech/M. Tech/MCA in Electronics/E&TC/IT/Computers Science/Computer Eng./Electrical/Mechanical or allied disciplines. MBA (Finance/Operations/Projects), PG Diploma in Contract Management/Project Management/PMP Certification.
qualification.details: Full time B.E/B. Tech/M. Tech/MCA in Electronics/E&TC/IT/ Computers Science/Computer Eng./Electrical/Mechanical or any allied disciplines from any recognized Institute/University. Master's Degree in Business Administration [MBA (Finance/ Operations/ Projects)], PG Diploma in Contract Management/Project Management/PMP Certification. At least 10 years of cumulative experience in Program/Project Management (i.e., Planning/Execution/Implementation and Monitoring of high value projects). Good experience/knowledge of preparation of documentation pertaining to projects like RFPs/EOI/Contract Agreements/MoU/LOIs/Work Order etc. Well versed with Govt. regulations (pertaining to conclusion of Contracts/Execution of projects), CVC guidelines, Labour Laws etc. Previously served/been employed in regular (non-contractual capacity) for a cumulative period of at least 20 years in CPSES, Central Government Group 'A' officers (including Armed Forces / Para military), or State PSEs (where annual turnover is 500 Cr or more for the past 3 years).

selection_process: Applications received shall be shortlisted for interview based on the candidate's credentials & suitability for the position. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview in physical/virtual mode. Candidate shall be selected by the Screening-cum-Selection Committee. Final selection depends on candidate's qualifications/experience
suitability for the post and performance in the interview.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for BECIL Principal Chief Projects Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.becil.com.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BECIL Principal Chief Projects recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Principal Chief Projects post is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal Chief Projects post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a full-time B.E/B. Tech/M. Tech/MCA in relevant engineering or computer science disciplines. A Master's degree in Business Administration or a PG Diploma in Contract/Project Management/PMP Certification is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Principal Chief Projects post is 60 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Principal Chief Projects position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 1,50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through Speed Post/Registered Post only. The detailed application procedure is provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Principal Chief Projects.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from the application fee. All other categories need to pay Rs. 295/-.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of experience is required for this post?
faq.answer: At least 10 years of cumulative experience in Program/Project Management is required, along with knowledge of government regulations and contract management.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications based on credentials, followed by an interview (physical/virtual mode).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the BECIL official website, www.becil.com.
